newsitem.title: USA: Centocor's stock drops on Lilly's caution about ReoPro.
newsitem.headline: Centocor's stock drops on Lilly's caution about ReoPro.

text.p: Centocor Inc. stock lost nearly a quarter of its value Monday after partner Eli Lilly and Co. cautioned about the future sales potential of ReoPro, a drug for fighting blood clots, analysts said.
Centocor's stock plunged by $7.125 to $23.375 in late trading on the Nasdaq market, where it was one of the most actively traded issues.
Company officials could not be immediately reached for comment.
Eli Lilly said sales for ReoPro and other new products drove its sales growth in the first quarter, but the company was more cautious about the future, analysts said.
Sales of ReoPro in the first quarter were $51.7 million, more than twice the year-ago level, Lilly said.
